crossrefs.text: His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”
Do you intend to correct my words, and treat as wind my cry of despair?
Even if I were righteous, my mouth would condemn me; if I were blameless, it would declare me guilty.

So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD, because he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance, and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.

Now when Jobʼs three friends—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite—heard about all this adversity that had come upon him, each of them came from his home, and they met together to go and sympathize with Job and comfort him.
Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
But now trouble has come upon you, and you are weary. It strikes you, and you are dismayed. Is your reverence not your confidence, and the uprightness of your ways your hope?
If God puts no trust in His servants, and He charges His angels with error,
If even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His sight,
Who can bring out clean from unclean? No one!
Surely there is no righteous man on earth who does good and never sins.
What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
Who can say, “I have kept my heart pure; I am cleansed from my sin”?
“Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”
What man is like Job, who drinks up derision like water?
Terrors frighten him on every side and harass his every step.
While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them.
Please inquire of past generations and consider the discoveries of their fathers.
And do not complain, as some of them did, and were killed by the destroying angel.
But the LordGod called out to the man, “Where are you?” “I heard Your voice in the garden,” he replied, “and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
When you till the ground, it will no longer yield its produce to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
Do not be excessively wicked, and do not be a fool. Why should you die before your time?
No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case honestly. They rely on empty pleas; they tell lies; they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
with kings and counselors of the earth, who built for themselves cities now in ruins,
By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of His anger they are consumed.
But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
